text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? What's up? Did you come all the way 
here just to congratulate me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Senpai! For the upperclassman I 
respect so much, I've been practicing 
singing for a whole week!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Now ain't that a classy thing for 
them to do!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, for my birthday, you'd better 
make it flashy enough to rival the 
fireworks of Edo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am!! For the birthday song, Bamboo 
Memory will take the stage!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
H-A-P-P-Y! B-I-R-T-H-D-A-Y! I'm so 
seriously grateful you were born!! Yes, 
ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gwahaha! Man, this is practically a fight 
song! It hits straight in the chest, 
Bamboo!!
